verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Microsoft Entra Domain Services provides managed LDAP and Kerberos/NTLM authentication for legacy apps that can't use modern authentication, which covers the cloud-LDAP half of the story. That capability comes from a separate managed domain service rather than Entra ID itself, and nothing in the pack shows a RADIUS endpoint serving VPNs or Wi-Fi. missing for 10: RADIUS endpoint support, evidence of VPN/Wi-Fi integration via legacy protocols, detail on LDAP setup and limits, independent or hands-on corroboration.
